globalDescription.english: At 05:41 Dewey approaches Cavite in line ahead. The Spanish ships start at rest. Five can get underway immediately. Castilla, Velasco and Don Antonio de Ulloa are immobile. Velasco retains her SK5 armament. Standard fleet-loss scoring applies.
globalDescription.chineseSimplified: 05:41，杜威率纵队驶向甲米地。西班牙舰队开局静止。五艘舰可立即起航，Castilla、Velasco 和 Don Antonio de Ulloa 无法自行航行。Velasco 保留 SK5 本舰武备。胜负按通用舰队损失规则判定。
